pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal regions with rounded vertices and smooth pixel-gradient transitions at the edges. Relative spatial area is highest on the neck and upper flank, decreasing noticeably toward the lower limbs and posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white pathways with consistent pixel thickness and distinct tri-radial junction nodes at the intersections of three patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette characterized by dense, short vertical projections against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Group of small, dark, punctate depressions located on the lower-mid flank, indicative of localized textural disruption or minor parasitic lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism (oxpecker) is perched vertically on the upper lateral neck area.
